notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the camp (1918), log cabin (1923), L-4 cab (1931) and destruction in the 1950s; none gives a single year for the destruction, so the brief's 1950 is corrected to the decade. Idaho Fire Lookouts has two pages named Moose Mountain Lookout; the Bonner County tower on the northern-idaho page is a different structure and was not used. The 6,603 ft Clearwater page matches the brief's record. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so no staffing is recorded. Coordinates in the brief (46.77956, -115.18512) match source 4. No photos were captured, and no source describes the site today.
